name: Leisure BECLA60CEK — 60cm Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Leisure BECLA60CEK is a 60cm freestanding electric cooker in black from the Classic range. Twin ovens — a 75L main fan oven and a 38L conventional second oven with integrated grill — sit over a four-zone ceramic hob with a hot-hob warning light. A fully programmable timer and catalytic liners make it easy to live with. A energy rated.
features: Twin ovens — 75L main fan + 38L second with grill
Triple-glazed main oven window & interior light
Fully programmable timer with LED display
